## WorkspaceRegistry

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Wpf.Models.WorkspaceRegistry</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Wpf/Models/WorkspaceRegistry.cs:15](../../../../src/Meridian.Wpf/Models/WorkspaceRegistry.cs#L15).

Static registry of workspace definitions for saved desktop templates. Each workspace maps to a set of related pages from Pages.cs. Page names must match the tags registered in NavigationService.RegisterAllPages(). Icon values are single-character Segoe MDL2 Assets glyph strings. The corresponding Segoe MDL2 Unicode code points are declared as StaticResource keys in Styles/IconResources.xaml (e.g. IconStrategy, IconTrading, IconAccounting). High-quality SVG source files for every icon live in Assets/Icons/*.svg.
